subject: Flexible renewal tiers + mid-contract top-up — AlderBio
messages:
From: Sandra Wu <sandra.wu@alderbio.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: AlderBio Procurement <procurement@alderbio.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal question: can we make mid-year top-ups easier?

Hi Mina,

Quick context — AlderBio is approaching our 12-month renewal and we expect a 40–60% ramp in inference consumption for the next 6 months due to a new feature launch. Legal has the renewal SOW I attached (Alder_Renewal_SOW_v2.pdf). Procurement asked if Redwood can: 

- Allow smaller mid-contract top-ups with pro-rated billing (monthly)
- Provide a staged discount as usage grows rather than a single uplift bracket
- Co-term the additional capacity to our existing renewal date instead of starting a new 12-month clock

Can you share what flexibility is feasible and the impact on pricing? We need a proposal to present to finance next week.

Thanks,
Sandra
Head of Platform Operations
AlderBio
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sandra Wu <sandra.wu@alderbio.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal question: can we make mid-year top-ups easier?

Hi Sandra — thanks for the note and the SOW. I reviewed the attachment and looped in Ben and Lauren to help with pricing and procurement mechanics. High level — we can support all three asks but there are trade-offs on discounting and billing complexity. 

Proposals to consider (quick, will follow up with numbers):
- Monthly top-ups: allow incremental buckets in units (reserved units or committed monthly bursts) billed pro-rata to the co-term date.
- Staged uplift discount: tiered % discount that increases at defined usage thresholds (e.g., 0–25%, 25–60%, 60%+ of committed increase) rather than a one-time uplift.
- Co-term: add a short amendment that aligns the bumped capacity to your renewal date and amortizes credit/discounts accordingly.

Request from your side: can you share a short usage profile (monthly tokens or requests) for the next 6 months? If you can export Q3 usage and send, that helps us model price per 1M tokens with the staged tiers.

I attached a request for a simple usage export format (usage-export-q3.csv) — send when you can and Ben will draft pricing scenarios.

Best,
Mina
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
[attachment: usage-export-q3.csv]
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 14:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal question: can we make mid-year top-ups easier?

Team — quick pricing thoughts after skimming Sandra's ask and the SOW:

1) Flexible monthly top-ups: operationally trivial if we treat them as "reserved burst buckets" with a monthly true-up. Financially, we should avoid ad-hoc deep discounts. Proposal: 5% admin fee for month-to-month top-ups + standard uplift pricing.

2) Staged uplift discount: agree this is customer-friendly. Suggest tiers mapped to incremental committed units (not absolute usage):
   - Tier A (small bump): +10–30% committed increase -> 8% discount on incremental units
   - Tier B (medium): +31–60% -> 12% discount
   - Tier C (large): 60%+ -> 18% discount but requires a 3-month minimum commit on the bumped portion

3) Co-term mechanics: we'll do a time-weighted amortization of discounts so AlderBio doesn't double-dip. Add a one-page amendment (redwood-draft-amendment.docx) that legal can iterate.

If we get the usage CSV from Sandra we can run 3 scenarios and present net ARR impact vs. base renewal.

Ben
Principal, Renewals
Redwood Inference
From: Sandra Wu <sandra.wu@alderbio.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: AlderBio Procurement <procurement@alderbio.com>, Evan Park <evan.park@alderbio.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 08:06:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal question: can we make mid-year top-ups easier?

Thanks Mina / Ben — attaching the Q3 export and a short forecast (see usage-export-q3.csv). A few clarifications from procurement: 

- Any increase needs to be on our existing invoice cadence (monthly) and show a clear proration line.
- Finance prefers a staged discount but wants the lowest possible upfront commitment. Is Tier A possible without minimums?
- Legal will want co-term language that prevents auto-renewal of the bumped portion beyond our renewal date.

I'll run this by finance today — can you aim to send the 3 scenarios by COB Monday (16 Nov)?

Sandra

[attachment: usage-export-q3.csv]
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sandra Wu <sandra.wu@alderbio.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 17:28:00 -0800
Subject: Pricing scenarios for AlderBio mid-contract bump — attached

Sandra — attached are three modeled scenarios based on your Q3 export: conservative, expected, and aggressive. Highlights: 

- Conservative: +20% bump, amortized to co-term, effective discount ~7% on incremental units; minimal operational requirements.
- Expected: +45% bump, staged discount with Tier B -> effective incremental discount ~11%; requires 3-month minimum on bumped portion for Tier B protections.
- Aggressive: +75% bump, Tier C economics -> 18% but requires 3-month minimum and an upfront notice for scaling windows.

Doc notes: the monthly top-ups will appear as separate line items and be prorated to your renewal date. We included a sample amendment to align co-term and amortization (redwood-draft-amendment.docx).

Attachments: redwood-draft-amendment.docx (amendment language), scenarios-model.xlsx (pricing math)

Can we set a quick 30-min call tomorrow to walk through finance and procurement questions? Available windows: Tue 11/17 10–12 PST or 15–16 PST.

Ben
From: Sandra Wu <sandra.wu@alderbio.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: AlderBio Procurement <procurement@alderbio.com>, Evan Park <evan.park@alderbio.com>
Bcc: procurement@alderbio.com
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 16:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pricing scenarios for AlderBio mid-contract bump — attached

Ben / Mina — finance reviewed the scenarios and prefers the Expected scenario (Tier B). A few asks before we sign:

- Can Redwood confirm that Tier B will be billed monthly, proration on first month only, and that the 3-month minimum applies only to the bumped portion (not the entire contract)?
- Procurement requests an explicit SLA credit if latency increases above 150ms P95 after the bump for two consecutive weeks.
- Please add a clause that the bumped units will not auto-renew beyond our renewal date unless mutually agreed.

If you confirm the three items we can route the amendment to legal and sign via DocuSign. Thanks for moving quickly on this.

Sandra
Head of Platform Operations
AlderBio
[attachment: Alder_Renewal_SOW_v2.pdf]
